rules.description: Pre-auth low threshold; origin lock and client 429 acceptance required
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/cli/auth/")))
